title: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

sense.text:
“And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea.” This cannot be a normal wind. It is windy every single day. It is a different type of wind, and 2 Esdras shows what it is: the armies of the earth.

This is the proof out of the Bible that the unity of the nation of Israel is what will get us salvation. Not a personal relationship with God: our people have had personal relationships with God for hundreds of years, and salvation has not come. Not living under grace either. Salvation is deliverance: preservation from destruction or failure, deliverance from danger, from our enemies and from bondage, which is sin. The Christian church never warns of the danger and destruction that is coming.

And what is the Most High God in the heavens waiting on before he sends his Son back? A specific number. 144,000 men must be sealed, and then deliverance will come. It is that simple. The Christian church has never even heard of the 144,000, and that lets you know it is not about salvation, the deliverance of our people. We must put our nation before ourselves.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”: this angel was sealed. “And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea.” The armies are being held back. The destruction is not coming yet.

“Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Nothing of mass proportions happens until 144,000 are sealed. So if you truly want the end to come, you will be out here teaching your people and raising up the nation of Israel.

The seal is the law (Isaiah 8:16), and it is set “in their foreheads”: the law is in your mind. The Bible makes it very simple what the seal of God is: keeping his commandments. Christianity says don’t keep the law, so it goes against the very thing the Bible says will bring salvation to our people. Pentecostal, Seventh-day Adventist, non-denominational: none of them are getting sealed. If you are not keeping the commandments and the faith of Christ, you are leading a life to damnation.

“And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” There are no other nations in the 144,000.

There are about 50 million so-called blacks in America alone, and a great many Hispanics. We number as the sand of the sea, and all we need is 144,000 unified in the law. The enemy, Esau, knows that too (Revelation 12:12), and he is working overtime to make sure it doesn’t happen.

It is like Game of Thrones. The South is royalty, it is hot all the time, and they don’t worry about winter; the North is cold and built different, with a different spirit on them. North and south battle each other all the time, everybody wanting to wear the crown: that is the Northern Kingdom and the Southern Kingdom, Hispanics and blacks, with gang wars, clout wars, east coast and west coast. That is the small battle. Meanwhile the real enemy is coming, the white walkers: the white man, whom we call the red man, who got his power from Satan. Many don’t want to believe that enemy is real, and some are trying to gather the north and south together to fight him. And the exile reclaiming her ancestral crown is Christ, who will take back his crown, with the government upon his shoulders.

precepts.why:
Ezra beheld “a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea.” A multitude of men gathered from the four winds: so the winds are the armies of the earth.

Those are the winds the four angels are holding in Revelation 7: the armies of the earth, sent to subdue the man and sent to bring destruction on this earth. That is why it is no ordinary wind, and until the angels let go, that destruction cannot blow.

What is the seal that must happen before those armies can hurt the earth? “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal is the law.

So how are you going to have 144,000 sealed in Christianity, when the church says don’t keep the law? It teaches the complete contrary of what the Bible calls on us to do, and that is why, for the gospel’s sake, they are our enemies. There is no unity in the Christian church. They don’t unify in keeping the commandments; they don’t unify on anything but wearing white on first Sunday. But among the ranks of the Israelites we understand what must be done to bring about salvation. That is why unity is the sweet savour of salvation.

Our job is to seal the law among his disciples. Once we have 144,000, salvation, deliverance from danger and the kingdom will all come. That is why it is of the utmost importance to learn, teach and apply the laws of God: that is how the end of this earth as we know it is brought about. They give you a million different things you have to do. It is very simple: 144,000 sealed with the law.

“Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.” Set a mark: set that seal, in the forehead, the same as Revelation 7:3.

But how are you going to sigh and cry about abominations if the law is done away with? What makes something abominable? The law. The Christian church says there is no law, so nothing is abominable to them, and it is impossible for them ever to get a mark set upon their heads in the church.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.”

That is what is going on in the church today. No difference between the clean and the unclean, no difference between the abominable and the holy. The scripture says rightly divide, and they don’t rightly divide anything: eat everything, drink everything, sleep with anything, everybody all-inclusive. So nobody in those religions can receive salvation. They have not set themselves up to be set apart when Christ returns.

Who else knows that we need to reach 144,000? Esau, the enemy, knows it too. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” Devil means deceiver. He does not assume it: he knoweth.

How does he know his time is short? He knows that if those Israelites, the so-called blacks and Hispanics, start coming together, his time is short. Unity is what will bring about salvation, and the great army of God rising up is the sign that his time is almost come to an end. When J. Edgar Hoover, director of the FBI, was asked what in his opinion was the single greatest threat to the United States of America, he answered: negro unity.

So if he understands that unity brings about our salvation, he will do any and everything to keep us divided. That is the eugenics tree: psychology; history, flipped through iconoclasm, so the Egyptians are shown white; education and the school-to-prison pipeline; mental testing, asking about furnaces, attics and basements that our people in the south never had; religion, law, politics, economics, archaeology, sociology; medicine, with medical apartheid, the Tuskegee experiment, COVID, ADHD and Ritalin made to dumb us down; anatomy, physiology, anthropometry; statistics that call us minorities and split us into labels, when blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans together outnumber them; ethnology; and geography, with a map that made Africa look smaller than it is.

sense.text:
Those who leave want to bring division. Why interview somebody who left an organization? To get someone upset and mad to tell their story to everybody. One who left said we study the Bible from sun up to sun down every Sabbath, so it must be a cult. Reading and teaching the Bible is what they call a cult. Nobody put a gun to anybody’s head: you came in the doors, opened your Bible and got the understanding.

They are addicted to the scriptures: “ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints.” That is what we do here. We are addicted. For those really in the fight it is no grudge to learn the Bible; when you addict yourself to it, you can listen to the word of God all day and night.

You would not have found out you are an Israelite if it were not for a camp, because the will to put a platform together to teach, educate and nurture our people does not exist with individuals. Everybody that leaves becomes a pastor for two weeks, teaches their own hatred and malice for about two months, and is never heard from again, because the spirit is not there. If what we are doing is evil, leave and build it yourself: in thirteen years nobody has. The spirit is here because we put the commandments and Christ first and foremost.

He was here for rank. Because there is rank, order and instruction, and he could not become the head after two weeks, now it is a cult. Everybody is trying to infiltrate this organization, and to infiltrate it you would have to learn the Bible and prove you believe what you teach. This is not set up by men; it is set up by God. When you come into the truth you don’t worry about rank. Most of the brothers who are captains now never cared about it. You are here to save your people.

“No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” Nobody that is truly at war, who understands who the true enemy is, is worrying about any damn rank, because he understands this is the organization changing our people and trying to get the 144,000. People copy our backdrop, our videos, our camp signs and our colours, but nobody has copied getting thousands of men on the streets. They have their unity camps, but they cannot march in order, because it is not fuelled by the right reasons.

“And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.” If you aspire to be a soldier, an officer, a captain, a deacon or a bishop, you will not be crowned unless you strive lawfully: not undercutting, undermining, slandering or lying. Leaving and crying and complaining will not get you crowned in that day when Christ returns.

He prayed for rank. Others come in praying only for a wife or only for a husband. Not everybody here is here for the right reasons, and not everybody has their mind on getting the kingdom of heaven, though that is what it should be.

precepts.why: It is biblical: “The fear of the Lord goeth before the obtaining of authority.” He came in the building to get a position, but that is not what we are here for. The main objective is to come in and get your spirit right, and in the doing of it the Lord will put you in the position you need to be in.

And why does he want rank? So he can be over somebody and tell somebody what to do. Christ spoke about that spirit: “Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.” In the world, the white man exercises lordship over the people. It is terrible.

“But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister.” Throughout the scriptures the good kings and good leaders did not ask for their positions; they were given to them and earned by them. A minister is the position we should all aspire to. The scripture says pray for more labourers to do the work, and he was praying for rank.

People want to teach class but don’t think about the hours it takes. They want to be the Bishop but don’t think about the thirty-eight years of reading books, travelling the world and dealing with councils and matters, or how long he sat under men learning. They see the thousands of men on the street, not the two years the Bishop was at camp by himself to bring in one person. You want to bring people in to bring forth the kingdom of heaven, not to have ten people you can tell what to do.

sense.text:
Religion is one of the ways the white man divides us on the eugenics tree. “Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” It does not mean they will literally say they are Jesus. It means they come under the banner of Christ: I’m a pastor, I’m a preacher, I’m an evangelist, I’m a prophet. That is how they come in the name of Christ and deceive many.

The Catholic church, the Pentecostal church, the Seventh-day Adventist church: all those religions are trash, and all of them fall under this scripture. Christianity is the number one religion in the world, with a white Jesus all over it. So is the scripture true? Absolutely.

“They are drunken, but not with wine”: our people are drunk. They wake up at eight in the morning and go to a church building with no liquor in them, and “they stagger, but not with strong drink.” Screaming in the church building, acting just like a drunk person on the street: no Bible open, no scripture read, no understanding coming out. Is anybody going to call that a cult? The Most High knew what he was doing when he put those words in the Bible.

And speaking in tongues: tongues is a language. That is why there is an interpreter. It is not a language that nobody understands.

“For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.” Deep sleep in these churches: the Lord put all of them to sleep.

That is why our people can be hung by the hundreds and they don’t say a word. Electricity can be out in thirty different cities and they don’t say a word. Our communities are dilapidated and they have no clue what is going on. The only pastor who has said anything about Nolan Wells is Jamal Bryant. All these black folks sitting up in white churches are not trying to leave. Our people are delusional.

This is the spirit in the Christian church: the 10,000-dollar seed, I’m not asking you, I’m telling you; fifteen people at a hundred dollars each tonight, working out how much the rent is. They are not dividing anything out of the Bible, and there is no example of any of the prophets teaching like that. Christ paid the people’s taxes.

“The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money.” Word for word, script for script. The church has to pay them a fee to come, and they come in there only for money, and none of the Christian pastors ever say a word about it.

It is all over the world. In Uganda, at a refugee camp near the South Sudan border, the brothers were given three services, as if they were American pastors come to run the people’s pockets. When the teaching started, the faces cringed, the mic was taken, and there was no second service, no third service, no radio show. At the offering the pastor faked putting money in the basket to motivate everybody else to give, and the basket was empty. People literally escaping civil war, with no money to give, and still they try to take whatever they have.

Brian Carn, a prosperity-gospel money pastor, is in prison for not paying his taxes and writes to the church as if he were a disciple locked up, kidnapped. Paul was locked up because of the gospel; he got locked up for his love of money. That is how religion is used.

It is only our own people who come against us, harder than anybody else. Black apologists say they can’t beat the Israelites and tell people to run from us; black pastors say we are saved by race, not by grace, and that our genealogy doesn’t matter. They know what we teach is true, but their masters will not allow them to leave us alone, because if they did, all men would believe on us. They get mad when we bring up identity, yet Christ said who he was and where he was from, and Paul, the one they love most, said he was of the tribe of Benjamin, an Israelite circumcised the eighth day.

Christianity and white supremacy want you to deny that you are an Israelite, because there is power in it. “What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?” What advantage is there in being an Israelite?

“Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.” In every way there is a profit and advantage to being an Israelite. Do they ever tell the so-called white man, the so-called Jew, that nobody cares if he is a Jew? Never. Only us. The Bible, the understanding, salvation was given to us. It was not given to all nations.

So yes, it is important to know that you are an Israelite, because once we understand it, we can unite. Black people can’t unite right now because we don’t know who we are. That is why they fight tooth and nail to keep you away from that identity. That is the gospel the Bible talks about.

precepts.why:
“For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh: Who are Israelites”. According to the flesh, not the spirit: his brethren and kinsmen are Israelites. Is it important to know who those people are? Absolutely.

When a trust is read out, not everybody is invited. Nobody can say that was my homeboy, we good: if your name is not written, you are not getting in. This book has covenants. A covenant is a trust, a contract, and not everybody is entitled to it. The white man thinks he can just take God’s contract with us, but that is not how contracts work.

“To whom pertaineth the adoption”: the adoption, from being a gentile back to being an Israelite, belongs to the Israelites. “And the glory, and the covenants”: that is the key part. If you are not part of a covenant, does it matter to you? When Trump dies, none of what he set up is going to me, because I am not his son. But when Christ comes back, his covenant is with us. “And the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises”: all the promises that are written were written to us and us only. That is why they don’t want you to know who you are, so you perish and get nothing.

But like a prenup, there are things written in this contract. If we don’t keep the commandments and the faith of Christ, we do not get the promises written in here. That is why they want to keep us divided and away from what we should be doing.

sense.text:
Politics: if they don’t get you caught up in religion to divide you, they get you caught up in politics. The token blacks brought to the White House in red hats; the pastor who bought balloons to celebrate his false prophecy and danced, God bless America. We say Babylon the great is America and is going to be burnt up; do you think he is joining us? These people love this place, and have forgotten all the atrocities done to their people. When did Joseph jump up and down saying God loves Egypt? Moses was learned in all the ways of the Egyptians, and he said, Let my people go. Nowhere do the prophets love the oppression they are in. Before we can deal with the white walkers, the real enemy, we have to deal with our own people.

“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”: our people have made a covenant with death, a covenant with America. When was America great to blacks and Hispanics? Never. There is no time period. Over seventy hangings documented in the last couple of years. Our people are in agreement with hell, with captivity. How is Christ going to rule while you pray for your oppressor to keep ruling over you? The scripture says you are supposed to be praying for vengeance.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”. When you accept America, his politics and his religion, you have hid yourself under lies. That is the political system. No matter who had won, he would have been cooning and dancing just the same.

Economics: economically we are oppressed and divided. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things.” We have to serve our oppressor in all things.

Jaylen Brown wanted to build like Black Wall Street and invest in his city, and he showed that the people around the most influential players steer them away from their communities and from helping the people they came from. Their agents and lawyers say it would be a better investment over there. Meanwhile white people take their money to their own community, come into black communities, buy them up, gentrify them and send the money back to their own people. They bring their businesses into your neighbourhoods but don’t want you owning business there, because then the money would stay. Pine Hills and Parramore: put hundreds of millions in, and nothing there will stay affordable.

Gentrification is a lower-income neighbourhood turned wealthier as people with more money move in, fix up buildings and drive up property values. Our athletes and singers have that money; one with 400 million could buy a whole city where every property costs a thousand dollars, rebuild it and put everybody on. But they are told it is not smart, while the white man does it himself and lives luxuriously. And our own people are used to go against the one who tries to do something positive for our people.

Even at the highest levels you are not exempt. Most athletes who make it to the top now have both parents in the house, and the father is very influential, because a father, even without the spiritual sense, will think about people other than himself and put on for everybody. A mother can be manipulated. So when they reach the highest levels, they want to count the father out and separate the players from their dads and families.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” Their sons are worth hundreds of millions, and they cannot influence them the way they want because of the NBA. There is no might in their hand, because at the end of the day the NBA signs the check. But with 100 million and businesses you don’t care about the NBA: LeBron has an enterprise built, and basketball doesn’t mean anything to him anymore. Every one of them could do the same, but they keep their minds in a box. Shut up and dribble.

J.R. Smith said it: five of them at 250 could build gyms, rec centres and leagues for the community, and what bank would turn them down? Unity is what’s needed. No one man can do it by himself. And the white man does it all the time: collaboration, Taco Bell with Frito-Lay, Nike with Apple, Yeezy with Gap and Balenciaga. Everybody understands unity is better except the black man, still fighting over who has nicer shoes, a bigger house, nicer cars. African-American buying power alone is estimated at about two trillion dollars a year, without the Hispanics or the Native Americans; they want all of it, and want us only to show up as customers. Even the white owner of Wingstop understands that the money is with us.

Back to unity: who is the enemy? We cannot unite unless we have a common enemy. Blacks and Hispanics cannot come together, and so-called Christians and Israelites cannot come together, until we understand that the white man is the enemy. We have to admit we are the Israelites and keep the commandments and the faith of Christ. That is the only way.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”. Who did the Lord send against us on the west coast of Africa? Who did he send against the so-called natives on this side of the earth? The so-called Portuguese, the Dutch, the French, all these Edomite countries, and they continue to oppress us to this day. The enemy of my enemy is my friend: we are all enemies of the white man, and we have to come together.

precepts.why:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The so-called black man is not ruling the earth, and the so-called Hispanic man is not ruling the earth. The white man is the one covering the faces: he is the face of the angels, the face of Christ.

And he says it himself. A white man said 90 to 95 percent of the black church is heretical, that there are not enough black men qualified to pastor black churches, and that the black church needs to be split up and go find a good God-fearing white church. He doesn’t care if you are an Israelite or in the Christian church: all of you need to bow the knee. While we argue and fight among ourselves, the white walkers are out there. He is telling you: we are the devil, and we are going to eat all of you alive.

sense.text:
Art imitates life. In Game of Thrones the king of the north has been in both kingdoms, and he knows it doesn’t matter what kingdom you own: if we don’t unite, we are all going to die. We have suffered at each other’s hands: gang violence, black-on-black crime. We can keep going back and forth, on social media and with the Christian church, but at the end of the day we need to repent to get out of here. He is symbolic of us: we don’t care where you come from; keep the commandments and the faith of Christ. It is not about colour, it is about the twelve tribes of the nation of Israel.

The same thing is coming for all of us. Those who were hung recently had no fringes on, and Nolan Wells was not keeping the Sabbath, and they got the same death. That white man hates you whether you keep the Sabbath or not, so you might as well keep the commandments, because this is the only place you will have any safety. And there is history behind it: David ruled, and when Solomon came there was peace for forty years. We are trying to get back to the kingdom, and again the white man is going to rise up, and it is going to get worse than it is now.

“Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble”. It is going to be hell, and all hands are needed on deck. That is why we pray for more labourers, fast and pray, and held the prayer vigil: we understand the times that are ahead. Our enemy, like the white walkers, doesn’t care about anything or anybody; all he sees is blood.

“But he shall be saved out of it.” Deliverance is coming; it is already written. We know where we will fall, and we are trying to get everybody else on board. In the show they fought together against the common enemy despite their differences, because their lives were on the line: the north and the south, as black and Hispanic did in the 60s and 70s, and as Israel did when David ruled over one kingdom. The queen still stuck on her terms is Christianity: what you say is true, but. It is bigger than the African Methodist Episcopal church. There is a white man out there hanging people.

The enemy wants us to stay divided, but Christ already warned us: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation”. We have to unite and keep God’s commandments, or we are not getting the kingdom.

That is what Captain Mattathias told the Christian pastors in the debate, his Jon Snow speech. All of it is a smoke screen: Christ did not come for all nations, he came only for the nation of Israel, and we get the kingdom of heaven by keeping God’s commandments. Outside these doors are hookers, drug dealers, gang bangers and killings, and we clean our people up by teaching God’s commandments, not by arguing about the Trinity. And where is the black church’s voice on Nolan Wells, Kendrick Johnson and Rasheed Carter?

That is our plea to the Christian church: we are not your enemy, and we do not hate you. We want you to keep the commandments and receive salvation, because at the end of the day nobody is going anywhere until 144,000 men are sealed. That is the mission.

Do our people know who the enemy is? They have no clue. Tell them the white man is the devil and they say who, what, when, where, why. They will not believe you, because it is a plot, and the Bible shows the plot. “But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”. The heathen are hindering our building. That is why they put us number three on the hate group list, and why every article about the Israelites carries the same picture of us marching in DC eight years ago. That is propaganda.

“And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building”. Like the secret plot exposed a few weeks ago: the head of the SPLC, the same list that puts IUIC at the top, was paying the KKK, and laundering money. No Christian church, no black pastor, no CNN said a word, and nobody reached out to the Bishop to apologize. But God forbid somebody trips at an IUIC camp. These things are set up on purpose to hinder what we have going on. It is not by chance.

“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” The Bible speaks about these things. We are not just complaining about everything that’s going on with no solutions or reasons. We know exactly what is going on.

So pastors need to humble down. Not find a good white church, as the white man said, but a good Israelite camp, a good Israelite leader who keeps the commandments and the faith of Christ. Those black pastors all went to the white man’s seminary and teach what he taught them. Shout Out Tuesday for the last ten years, then IUIC in the Classroom, then 15 Minutes with the Captain: history, precepts and prophecy for years, an online seminary, all free.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” The crafty counsel is to divide us as a people. Things are going on in the background you don’t see; meetings are held to keep any and everybody away from us. A hundred thousand followers and ten views, while somebody with two followers gets eight million.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” They want to cut us off from who we are. They never want you to remember that you are an Israelite. They want you to be black, a gentile, Asiatic, Zulu, anything else. The second you say you are an Israelite, it is a problem, because when the true Israelites come together in unity, the whole world crumbles.

And that hit list starts with Esau and goes down to the other nations. Esau is the main enemy, teaching the other nations to hate us and be confederate against us, cultivating the hate from the Arabs, the dusty Africans, the Japanese and the Chinese. The Bible is not talking about just one enemy.
“Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we”. Is that true today? Absolutely. We are still more and mightier than every other nation.

“Come on, let us deal wisely with them”. They deal wisely. Black man, don’t spend money in your own community. When you get rich, go marry a white woman, marry Chinese women. Sisters, your hair isn’t beautiful; buy weave, put makeup on. All these plots so they can tap into our resources.

Gold wins wars. The fight is spiritual, and we don’t have the resources to fight against America. But if every dollar that went to weave, to Jordans, to a double cheeseburger came back to us, we might have a chance: 1.9 trillion. That is why they never want us to tap into each other.

“Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying, Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” That is the mindset of your enemy: let us break their bands.

precepts.why:
What are the bands? “Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.” The bands are the brotherhood between the Northern Kingdom and the Southern Kingdom, and that is the mindset: keep them divided. Twelve years in Orlando, and four Northern Kingdom brothers in the room. They don’t want us to unite as a people.

The plot is working right now, but it is not going to work forever. That stupor is going to lift. Ten tribes make up the Northern Kingdom, so we are nowhere near where we are supposed to be size-wise until you see ten Latino-looking brothers to two of Judah. That is what it is supposed to look like by the tribes, and the Lord is going to speed up the time.

And they did break the brotherhood. Out of their own mouths: a Mexican on the phone calling us niggas when we are not around; a family saying black people are lazy; Latino programs built for Latinos only, while the black ones always include them; an old Mexican man yelling at a brother every morning in East LA. And dumb blacks say Hispanics and Native Americans cannot be our people, as if they don’t suffer the same curses: have you ever heard of ICE, or a reservation? We are the same exact people. We have no problem with the Northern Kingdom. We love the Northern Kingdom.

sense.text:
“The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah”. That hatred among one another will be gone when Christ returns, and as we come into this truth that spirit goes away. “And Judah shall not vex Ephraim.” A time is coming when the hatred among the tribes will cease, thus saith the Lord. Division is what the enemy wants.

When black people unify, that is an act of rebellion against the American government. In the late 1960s the FBI’s counterintelligence program, COINTELPRO, was set up to surveil, misinform, misdirect and destroy black groups, and its main intention was to prevent the rise of a messiah who could unify and electrify them. They never wanted you to revolt. It has not changed: now it is called black identity extremists, and they discredit leaders to break up groups. Billion-dollar buildings, and people who get a check on the 1st and the 15th, so that we will not unite. And still some leave here and run to the same people to tell everything.

Unity is the savour of salvation. The Bishop was saying it years ago: Israel must unify; that is what God is commanding us to do. Without that mindset fifteen years ago we would never have got where we are. We have to have a mindset of unity.

We see the division; now the solutions. First, we must marry our own people. Marriage brings unity, because marriage is the foundation of nationhood. “Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”. “Our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.” Marrying outside your race, the Bible calls whoredom.

“Now therefore, my son, love thy brethren”: unity is when you love your own people and marry your own people. “And despise not in thy heart thy brethren, the sons and daughters of thy people, in not taking a wife of them”. When you marry outside your race you despise your own people. That is hatred: you hate yourself. As the Bishop says, show me who you are married to and I’ll show you who your allegiance is to.

precepts.why:
We must marry each other. “My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers. When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed, trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” Marry your own people. “So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.”

The Bible speaks about race. That is why the Christian church is a joke: how are you going to marry your own people when you don’t know who you are? We are kingdom-minded, they say; what nation is that? The white man says he is in the kingdom too. No: your race, magnified. That is how we break the bands put on us and destroy the secret plots: we must marry and love one another.

“And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.” We must get back to separating ourselves. That is what is dangerous to them: Black Wall Street was bombed because they were separate.

sense.text: Second, we must be separate in our faith. To really be unified, we must all have the same faith. “Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him, and fall away every one from the religion of their fathers, and give consent to his commandments”. We have a religion. Anybody still saying this is not a religion doesn’t know what they are talking about.
“Yet will I and my sons and my brethren walk in the covenant of our fathers. God forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.” That is the religion of our fathers.

“We will not hearken to the king’s words, to go from our religion”. When you leave the law, the statutes and the commandments, you are leaving the religion that was given to you. We cannot unite under any other banner, under any other religion. Our religion is the faith of Christ and the commandments.

precepts.why: Death and destruction come to those who leave. “This is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.” Everybody that keeps the commandments comes to life and leaves the congregation of the dead. Leave the laws of God, and death is coming. Get down or lay down: keep the commandments at all costs.

sense.text: We must be united in our faith; we cannot be shaken. “Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold” and “set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.” He set up a large statue.

“That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up”: when you hear this, everybody has to bow down and worship.

“And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.” They understood what was going to befall them. Still they would not turn to the left hand or the right from their fathers’ religion, for the commandment is that you shall have no other gods before him.

Did they follow the example Mattathias left, and not hearken to the king’s words to leave their religion? “These men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.” They didn’t give a damn.

“Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring” them, and they were brought before the king and questioned. The point is that they faced death right in front of them, and they did not waver.

“Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel; Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do”. Other people want to worship our God. They say they seek our God as we do, and that they have done sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, who brought them up hither.

“Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel”. Asked in an interview whether white people can come join, the answer is no, they cannot join us, and they were mad. But that is what our forefathers did. The same way we were told to build it, that is the way we are going to build it. We must separate.

We must marry ourselves, we must separate ourselves in faith, and we must separate in all other facets: economically and spiritually. “Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways. For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.”

“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. We must leave these religions and be separate. That is the only time Christ is going to receive us: once we leave Christmas, Thanksgiving, the Fourth of July and the Memorial Day cookouts. Then Christ can deal with us, and then we can truly unify as a people.

What happens at the Martin Luther King parade? Shooting and fighting. At the Christmas club party? A shootout. The same at all these festivals: death. We must leave these things, because they are not our traditions or our culture.

“Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces”. That is what has happened to our people. We associate ourselves with American society, and for the most part a lot of our people have to. We are at the mercy of the white man: he gives us power, water, electricity, our cars, our TVs, and we produce none of it. We leave ourselves vulnerable.

Gary, Indiana, a majority-black city, went weeks without power after storms while paying higher rates than ever, while the state builds infrastructure for 125 data centres. Then the same in Memphis, and in a city in Texas: only where black people are. They are testing us to see whether we are prepared. That is why it is important for us to unite as a people, because the enemy doesn’t care about us. Is he not the man who controls the power, who poisoned the water, who poisons the chicken nuggets? He is the devil.

Once we do these things, we can receive salvation. There is one way we are going to unite: one king, one power, one authority, and that is Christ. “The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.”

We will not unite under the banner of Seventh-day Adventist, of FBA, of the Black Panther Party. The gathering of the people shall be unto Christ. That is why nobody can unite at the levels and speed we can: the only way blacks and Hispanics can unite is under Christ. That is why those movements lasted three or four years and were destroyed, and this movement has been around over a hundred years and is still moving. It has not reached its peak yet.

precepts.why: “Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him”. Our gathering together is unto him, at his coming: the gathering of the people unto Shiloh.

sense.text: “I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called, With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love; Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” Unity is the calling, and we are to endeavour to keep it.

precepts.why: “For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ”. Till we all come, blacks, Hispanics, Latinos, Native Americans, into the unity of the faith, unto the measure and fulness of Christ: the twelve tribes.
